name: learning-path
title: Learning path: a help that starts small, a guided workflow, and no learner traps
description: The README concedes spec-kit a gentler learning curve. The cause measured here: `--help` is one 120-line index of 70 commands with no order of use, and three traps met on a first run (a marketing heading, `init <feature> --write` failing without naming the spec command, an audit bundle stamped with a stale version). No gate-chain change: decision 4 of docs/EVOLUTION-PLAN.md stands.
